QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Infiltrating the Keep
QuestInfo.0: You try to enter the keep, but the entrance is sealed, leaving you to wonder what you should do now. Talk to Jack about your next step.
QuestInfo.1: Jack says someone must have activated the keep's security system. You might be able to learn how to bypass it if you speak with Taggrin the Raven Ninja.
QuestInfo.2: You met Taggrin in Phantom Forest.

npc.0: Go find one of them--anyone who can do something about this! I can trust you, right?
